description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipAPI class for managing employee membership data within the Human Resource Management system. It extends an endpoint class and implements CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for employee memberships via API endpoints, including detailed validation rules, request handling, and interaction with the EmployeeMembershipService and DAO layers.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPI
classes.description: Controller class providing REST API endpoints for managing employee membership data, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion functionalities, with validation and service layer integration.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EmployeeMembershipService used for business logic operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific employee membership by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring employee number and ID are valid.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all memberships for a specific employee, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing employee memberships, including access checks and sorting/pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new employee membership.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new employee membership, including required fields and constraints.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for request body parameters when creating or updating memberships.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee membership.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a membership, including validation for presence and format of fields.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or multiple employee memberships for a given employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deletion requests, especially for the IDs array.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Handles the process of creating or updating an EmployeeMembership object based on request parameters.
